_comment: Node-mode provenance must survive the shim being tree-shaken. `shim.mjs` is ESM by definition format, so Node's ESM/CJS interop applies to the namespace it imported and the wrapper must be `__toESM(mod, 1)` — which makes `ns.default` the raw `module.exports` rather than an `__esModule`-declared `default`. Linking collapses the re-export chain onto the external's namespace symbol, so the reference reaching the inclusion pass belongs to `main.js` (not ESM); the importing module has to be recovered by walking the symbol link chain.
